gameTitle: A Simple Life with My Unobtrusive Girl

majorBody: The major version changes when new events and gameplay are added
Log in with a verified account to get the new version
Or manually download the latest version from the store
patchBody: Regular bug fixes and gameplay improvements
Some experimental content may also be added through patches
You will receive an in-game notice when a patch is released
revisionBody: Frequent update pop-ups aren't very elegant
Urgent fixes and minor changes will be applied silently
Restart the game after a silent update to load the latest data

tipSaveMobile: The Android version doesn’t support quick access to the save directory for now
Please go to the '/storage/emulated/0/Documents/sister_save' path yourself
to check the save files! You’re free to transfer save data from other devices or
the PC version to inherit your progress.
autoUpdate: Update available: Version ${} game data detected.
Would you like to download and update now?
mvSaveToMzConvertConfirmText: ${} save data file(s) from an older version (MV version) have been detected.
Would you like to convert these save files to the current MZ version format
so they can continue to be loaded and used?
mvSaveToMzConvertTipsText: When you place MV version save files into the save folder,
the save conversion process will be triggered automatically.
After a successful conversion, the save files will be converted into
a format readable by the current MZ version and will appear on the Load screen.
This process will not delete the original MV version save files.
However, if an MZ version save file with the same slot number already exists,
the conversion will not be triggered again.
This feature is currently still in development and testing.
If you believe any data was lost after conversion,
please keep your original MV version save files and report the issue on our Discord server.
mvSaveToMzFailed: No save data found that requires conversion.

outdatedVersionWarning: A major game update is available. The latest version is ${}.
Automatic updates for major versions are only available to logged-in users who have completed purchase verification.
If you are unable to complete purchase verification, please download and install the latest version manually from the platform where you purchased the game.
After updating, you can transfer your save files manually or use the game's cloud save feature to carry over your progress.
outdatedVersionWarningForJapanPlatform: A major game update is available. The latest version is ${}.
Automatic updates for major versions are only available to logged-in users who have completed purchase verification.
Your current copy of the game is from DLsite or FANZA.
These platforms do not currently support purchase verification, so automatic updates for major versions are unavailable.
Please download and install the latest version from the platform where you originally purchased the game.
After updating, you can transfer your save files manually or use the game's cloud save feature to carry over your progress.
nonHardwareAccelerated: The game is currently running on integrated graphics!
If your PC has a dedicated GPU, we recommend setting Game.exe
to use it in your graphics control panel for a smoother gaming experience.
isAmdCPU: Your CPU is detected as an AMD processor.
Some AMD chips may experience frame drops when playing VP9 (WebM) videos
in a Chromium environment. If you encounter this issue, try forcing the game to
use GPU rendering or update your drivers to help alleviate the problem.
failedToLoad: This kind of issue may be caused by:
① Game files corrupted or filenames garbled due to encoding issues during extraction/installation.
② The developer forgetting to include the file—please wait for a patch update to fix it.
lowResModeWarning: This feature is mainly for performance optimization on Android devices and may have little effect on the PC version.
When enabled, the game renders maps and images at a lower resolution and then scales them up,
reducing GPU load on mobile devices and lowering heat generation and power consumption.
Note: This is an experimental feature, and its effectiveness may vary depending on the device.
You can disable this feature at any time to immediately restore full image clarity.
cloudSaveServiceWarning: This is the legacy Google Drive-based cloud save feature.
Now that the official cloud save system is complete,
this feature is scheduled to be deprecated and removed in a future update.
This cloud save feature will connect to your Google Drive
and store your game saves in the NLCH/save folder.
Uploaded save files will only be used for future synchronization and downloading back
into the game. They will not be used for any other purpose.
Do you agree to grant the game access to your Google Drive?
uploadSaveFile: Downloading a save file from Google Drive will overwrite your current local save data!

firstTimeNotice: This ownership verification feature is currently experimental.
You can sign in with Patreon here,
or link your Itch account for ownership verification.
If you have an active subscription,
or already own the game on Itch,
you can use features such as major update auto-patching.
At this time, verification is only available for players
who bought the game on Itch or Patreon,
or players with a paid Patreon subscription.
